name: Gulf / US–Iran war
summary: Iran says it is far from a deal after US strikes near Hormuz on 2 Nov
state: US forces struck Qeshm Island on 2 Nov in what officials called defensive strikes after the IRGC fired on a US aircraft (Gulf News, CBS). On 3–4 Nov Iranian officials said the sides remain far from a deal and that Hormuz will reopen only if the US lifts its blockade and sanctions (SBS). A tanker was hit by two projectiles off Oman on 3 Nov.
for_you: Follow FCDO travel advice for Iran and the Gulf states.
rubric_hit: Active state strikes and Hormuz substantially closed = Alert

sources.title: SBS News — Iran says 'long way to go' until end of war

why: Direct hostilities between Iran and the US or Israel threaten Gulf energy infrastructure, the Strait of Hormuz and the wider region.
drivers: Strikes and retaliation, attacks on shipping and Gulf states, mediation and ceasefire talks, US force posture.

rubric.alert: Active strikes between states, attacks on Gulf energy infrastructure or shipping, or the Strait of Hormuz substantially closed.
rubric.watch: A ceasefire or stalemate with sporadic strikes, or credible threats of renewed strikes.
rubric.normal: No direct state-on-state hostilities; diplomacy active.
